title: How India Reached Mars on a Budget

lines.text: In 2014, India reached Mars on its very first try.
No country had ever done that before.
The whole mission cost about seventy four million dollars,
less than the Hollywood movie Gravity.
So how did ISRO do it so cheaply?
First, the rocket was a proven workhorse, the PSLV.
Instead of one powerful push, the spacecraft circled Earth for weeks,
raising its orbit step by step before sailing to Mars.
Smart engineering, not big money, made history.
